messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled model-catalog cutover for 1736123456. Rolling canary: comet-13b -> comet-13b-quant. Canary window 60m, initial traffic 5%. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/catalog-cutover. :rocket:
emily: ack, thanks. quick ask — is fallback ordering final for this cutover?
rahul: yuk, here's the fallback list we landed on earlier: primary=comet-13b-quant, fallback=orion-quant, fallback2=pegasus-7b. We reorder to prefer quantized variants first to reduce cost.
sasha: oncall: please confirm rollback thresholds. we need SLO guardrails in the deploy message.
leo: agreed. proposed thresholds in short: p50 latency +100ms over baseline for 10m OR error-rate spike >0.5% sustained 5m -> auto-rollback. Also if embeddings drop relative quality >2% on smoke set -> manual rollback.
maria: ops note: catalog switch touches routing priority map. i've queued the config patch: `cfg/catalog/priority-2024-11-11.patch` — will run a dry apply at T-30.
emily: can we pin traffic for high-volume customers? want to ensure no noisy tenants get affected.
rahul: yes — pin list is in the patch. example snippet:
```yaml
pins:
  - customer: acme-inc
    model: comet-13b
    traffic: 0.0  # keep on old variant
  - customer: beta-labs
    model: comet-13b-quant
    traffic: 1.0
```
leo: canary plan: 5% overall, split regionally: us-west 2.5%, eu 1.5%, apac 1% during the 60m window. if metrics look good at 30m we'll jump to 25% for next 30m.
sasha: reminder: coordinate change window with infra maintenance — there is a pre-scheduled infra patch at +90m. do not overlap.
emily: deploy checklist quick: 1) pin file applied, 2) priority map dry-run OK, 3) canary launch, 4) smoke eval (3 prompts), 5) monitor latency/errors, 6) escalate if any regression -> rollback.
maria: added observability panels for this cutover: model_p50, model_error_rate, model_qcap (quality-check). alert thresholds wired to #oncall.
rahul: small note about fallback ordering edge-case: if quant variant OOMs under long seq, router should skip to fallback2 instead of falling back to CPU-hosted slower variant. i added a guard in the router config to prefer compatibility by memory footprint.
leo: ok to go from eng side after T-30 dry run. who wants to own the rollback call?
sasha: i'll own rollback during the window. if i ping :rotating_light: we execute `catalog rollback --cutover 1736123456` and demote the new variant.
emily: one more: release notes blurb for customers. draft: "Comet-13b quantized variant enabled as primary for lower latency and cost. Select enterprise customers pinned to legacy variant." i'll add to the docs site after deploy.
deploy-bot: DRY RUN at 1736123490: applied patch to staging priority map, no conflicts. logs: `apply ok`
leo: looks clean. proceed to scheduled canary at T+0.
rahul: starting canary rollout now — pushing 5% traffic. tracking metrics: p50 baseline=120ms.
maria: smoke evals running: 3 prompts -> quality delta 0.4% (within threshold).
sasha: monitoring: p50=135ms (approx +15ms), error 0.02% -> good.
emily: tagging release notes with version: comet-13b-quant@v1.2.0
leo: holding for 30m, if all good we ramp to 25%.
sasha: HOLD 30m
[30m passes]
rahul: ramping to 25% now.
maria: observability: p50=140ms, error 0.05%, smoke quality 0.6% delta. still within acceptable.
emily: marketing note posted to #announcements: "Model catalog: comet-13b-quant promoted as default for cost-optimized workloads"
leo: ramp complete. updating priority map to default ordering.
sasha: closing canary window. leaving monitoring for 4h. if any auto-rollback triggers, i'll coordinate.
emily: final checklist done. thanks everyone. :tada:
deploy-bot: Completed cutover for 1736123456. Status: success. Canary metrics: stable. Rollback candidates: none.
rahul: after-action items: add one more guard in router to treat long-seq OOMs as immediate fallback to fallback2. i'll open a ticket.
leo: i'll follow up with a brief postmortem template in #eng-releases in 24h.
sasha: thanks all — handover to steady-state monitoring.
